item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 12/Nov/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Toraji will move across the northern part of the South China Sea and edge closer to the western coast of Guangdong and the seas east of Hainan Island in the next couple of days. It will then weaken gradually but the rate of weakening remains uncertain. Under the combined effect of Toraji and the northeast monsoon, it will be windy with squally showers over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. A strong northeast monsoon is expected to affect southern China early to midweek next week. Tropical Cyclone Usagi over the seas east of the Philippines will intensify gradually and move in the general direction of the vicinity of Luzon Strait in the next couple of days. Its subsequent movement is uncertain with a higher chance of moving towards the seas east of Taiwan.
